eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Seven
subtitle: Lesson 28 · SQL Server Agent & Automation

code:
msdb.dbo.sysjobs
    one row per job: job_id, name, enabled

msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory
    one row per step run, plus a
    step_id = 0 summary row per job run
caption: Most monitoring queries filter to step_id = 0.

code:
CASE h.run_status
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Failed'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Succeeded'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Retry'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Canceled'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'In Progress'
END AS status
caption: run_status is an integer — memorize the mapping.

code:
SELECT
    j.name AS job_name,
    msdb.dbo.agent_datetime(h.run_date, h.run_time)
        AS run_datetime
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs AS j
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory AS h
    ON j.job_id = h.job_id
WHERE h.step_id = 0;
caption: agent_datetime() converts packed integers into a real datetime.
